note: Every action must carry the agent's own decision_ref (provider_response_id, or scripted:<n> in integration-only runs). The sidecar/controller never originates an action.

checked: P0-6: a read with one of the task's own read_tools is admissible whenever the task is open and its dependencies are satisfied, even when READ is not a closing kind (observation_only; never closes a non-READ task)
P0-6: for READ-kind tasks a read may be admissible as plain observation (OBSERVATION_ONLY) before dependencies are confirmed, but it is recorded stale and does not close the task
for non-READ tasks with open dependencies: DEPENDENCIES_OPEN (transient)
non-enum identifiers come from confirmed upstream evidence (IDENTIFIER_PROVENANCE)

P0-11: after the task is CONFIRMED an own-read_tools read stays admissible (observation_only) once per distinct (tool, args) while its dependents are not yet closed; only an exact repetition under unchanged causal state is throttled as ALREADY_CONFIRMED, and any state change re-admits it
read.retry: P0-8: transient CAUSAL_REFUSAL retried under until polling / max_s

checked: PLUS governed gate independently: ZTL evidence, CAGE seal, VEIP/warrant (never weakened; this layer only stricter)
task has recipients (NO_RECIPIENTS corrective route lists the agent's communication tasks)

P0-12: admitted when refs include at least one fresh valid in-chain observation and no unknown/wrong-task ref; stale in-chain refs are ignored and reported in the controller log and the agent's hint (stale_refs/valid_refs), refused only when no valid fresh ref is cited or a ref is fabricated/outside the chain (UNKNOWN/STALE/WRONG_TASK)
REFUSE in task.kinds (refusing a COMMUNICATE task is KIND_NOT_ALLOWED with a send-under-<task> corrective hint)
admitted refusal notes remaining COMMUNICATE obligations
AGENT_DONE alone never closes a non-DONE obligation
refused with EXIT_BLOCKED_OPEN_OBLIGATIONS while any mandatory obligation of the agent is unconfirmed

retry_contract: P0-7/P0-8: verdicts carry transient/underlying_code/observation_only; REPEAT_BLOCKED is tracked per (fingerprint, refusal reason, registry state digest) and never survives a state change; the scripted decider retries transient CAUSAL_REFUSAL like gate DEFERRED/BLOCKED (writes under retry_blocked_max_s, reads under until polling, sends/analyzes await-style bounded by max_s or 180 s default)
